title: Bibliyotek Video
head: Bann video ki finn selekte lor langaz ki pe dispar. Klike lor enn kart pou gade.

videos.title: Film Dokimenter: Langaz Perdi ek Remembre
videos.description: enn film dokimenter lapresib ki trase koz bann langaz pe dispar — migras, asimilasyon ek gloubalisasyon — avek enterflyo ek anarv rezonmanyen.

videos.title: Zet Kazy: Dernye Pale Ze enn Langaz
videos.description: zet kazy personal ki suiv dernye pale zenn langaz ki menase, montre linpak kiltirel ek lhistwar personel.

videos.title: Revitekasyon ek Docimentasyon
videos.description: Sentar lor linquist, kominote ek proze baz popileir ki travay pou dokimant, arkeve ek revoze langaz ki an danze.

videoLibraryDescription: Bann video sélectioné lor bann langaz ki pe disparet. Klik enn kart pou gad video.
